focus: Use the same SharedFocus mutex as the other macro; release during travel and waits.

departure.require: Verify the equipped Kraken hotkey for the current character; do not assume another PW has identical slots.
departure.activation_evidence: Game chat: Active buff from Kraken L3 activated; warp engine glows.
departure.ordering: Self target, activate Kraken, then submit navigation under the same short focus ownership.
departure.native_navigation: 0x009b toggles warp off if already warping. Submit only when idle.
